atoms.b: The new school year is coming up and Ms McConnell started shopping online for all the things she needs to get for her woodworking class. She adds ((++80 -80)) poles of pine wood to the shopping basket. Apart from that, she also needs plywood, so ((++40 -40)) sheets of that are also added. Thanks to a generous parent, she does not need to add more saws, since she received ((++20 -20)) saws for her class.

instruction.text: Now, read the second part of the text and select which integer would represent the item in the shopping basket.

atoms.text: Ms McConnell knows that woodworking is a dangerous task and that she must be well-equipped. She doesn’t have enough pairs of safety goggles, so she adds 12 pairs to the basket. She still has 21 protective ear-muffs for all of her students, but is missing a package of dust masks. Given that no one hurt themselves in the previous school year, she still has 2 brand-new first-aid-kits. After double-checking her list, she is ready to place the order.
